description: Cluster-wide triage of ML job problems: counts warning/error notifications per job and message type over the last N hours from .ml-notifications-*. Start here to see which jobs are failing and why (delayed data, no data, datafeed extraction errors, no node to start, memory).

configuration.query: FROM .ml-notifications-* | WHERE DATE_DIFF("hour", timestamp, NOW()) < ?hours AND level IN ("warning", "error") AND job_type == "anomaly_detector" | EVAL kind = CASE(message LIKE "*ingest latency*", "delayed_data", message LIKE "*no data*", "no_data", message LIKE "*extracting data*", "extraction_error", message LIKE "*No node found*", "no_node", message LIKE "*memory*", "memory", message LIKE "*flushing*", "flush_error", "other") | STATS n = COUNT(*), latest = MAX(timestamp), example = MAX(message) BY job_id, level, kind | SORT n DESC | LIMIT 100
